description: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. PqChat TreeKEM secrets (frozen after T1b: a record or derivation change restarts every vector). Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md §5 (path secrets, ps[0] over pathContext, the path ciphertext, the schedule without init, K, the tree wrap, the info and the marker) and §10 (replay), plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md T1b; by src/treekem.js, the worlds of scripts/treekem-fixture.mjs. H(ikm, info, n) = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm, salt empty, info, n); labels are scaas/pqchat/v1/tree/<name>. people: UAs (mldsa65, pqKeygen of rnd(tree-secrets/mldsa65-bip39-seed, 64), account 0, index; A … H named in the order of their UAs, so every session's members are strictly sorted by (ua, keyId)) and their public keys; devices: a person's KEM version keyId (A2 = A's version 2), kemSeed = HKDF-Expand(HKDF-Extract("scaas.ua.kem.v1", rnd(tree-secrets/kem/<person>, 64)), "scaas.kem.1" ‖ ua ‖ be64 keyId, 96). secrets: per commit of the main world its pathContext, ps[0] = H(kemSeed, …/commit ‖ pathContext), ps[0..m] and the node key hashes. pathCt: inputs and outputs of each path ciphertext of the first two commits. schedule: ctx, S, K from the joiner and the context fields. scenarios: each world's genesis, steps (a commit with every piece and its signature, or a landed treeLeave / treeRemove kept under the head), rosters per epoch, the pin of every epoch, and each device's replay: per epoch of its secret range [epoch, state, reason], K, [info, inForce, flagged], the compromise warnings, the reads in order and the pin of the head (C25, C26: the forward walk from the cold tree; an exit's views without treeId). signers: every signer's registry record (kind, keyData; an msig updated on its registry also versions: [{version, msig, enabled}], its msigAt answers for versions >= 1, CTR-UA-74), the keyless admins M (msig 2-of-2), W (WebAuthn) and N (msig 2-of-2 updated to version 1: a slot appended, threshold 1, slot 0 disabled; F-1) and X (msig 1-of-2 over N and a key, never updated: a signing msig member, world msig-nested, the fix check's R-1) included (F-3); an msig's signature names its version in signature (empty: 0, else 8 bytes big-endian) and is judged at that version only (the reader rule; world msig-history: N's version-0 removal by a slot the update disabled, F-1b); a pin's msigVersions: [ua, version] the highest version each msig's records named before its exits, a signing msig member's tag included (versions never decrease); devices: kemSig, the person's setKemKey signature of the key (kemKeyAt serves {kemPk, sig}; a cold tree's keys are authenticated by it, C-1); a signature is hex (a single key) or {signature, members} (an msig's abi.encode(MemberSig[])). lies: an endpoint's views replaced by read name, the device and its pin, and what replay and prepare give (null: accepted; plan T11). Path-less Adds (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-25-treekem-pathless-add.md §4, §6): every epoch's S has four branches, K = H(S, …/key), next = H(S, …/next), confirmTag = H(S, …/confirm ‖ ctx) (epoch 0: ‖ genesisCtx), each schedule row with next and confirmTag; a path commit's joiner as before, a path-less Add's H(next of its parent, …/add-joiner ‖ treeId ‖ epochId ‖ hash(adds)); its nonce the first 8 B, big-endian, of H(kemSeed, …/add-nonce ‖ treeId ‖ parentEpochId ‖ parentTreeHash ‖ hash(adds) ‖ be32 try) (a uint64, written as a bare integer). The tag decides the key state, sealedInfo only the info ('not taken' when it fails). States: followed; not followed with a reason (tag, parent not followed, welcome may not match, opening failed, ...); author did not hold (C45: the chain's key kept, no info in force); compromise (an own path-less record whose nonce no try reproduces, C47, or whose nonce is reproduced but whose tag the device's chain does not give, F-1, owner 2026-11-28, anchored or not: no key, and no chain until a path commit). Replays also give suspects (the C45 epochs), review (the still-live leaves those and the warnings name), sincePath, pathWarning (an admin's device at sincePath >= W(N)) and head (the head's handle with its next, when held). pathless: addNonce rows (try 0 and 1), addJoiner rows, twins (two children of one parent, a twin under one id), exitNext (a holder of next at an exit does not derive the honouring path commit), warn (W(N)). UNAUDITED.
